# 列表有界时，开始成立与不再成立同步：有界普查的世界中生起复现恰当止息复现 / With a bounded list, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace: in a world with a bounded census, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does

## 主张 Claim

一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出、每步至多 B 个（Listed，列表长度不超过 B），且每步可判定时，在任意晚的步有成员开始成立，就在任意晚的步有成员不再成立（Listed.ceasing_of_coming）。证明：从某步 N 起，一次开始成立若此前没有不再成立，那么 N 时成立的其后都仍成立，开始成立者不在 N 时的列表中，列表比 N 时长（Listed.ceases_or_kept、Listed.ceases_or_more）；列表不能长过 B，所以 N 之后必有不再成立（Listed.ceases_within）。与普查定律（ceasing-needs-arising）合起来，两者同步（Listed.coming_iff_ceasing）。读于活动：在每步至多 B 个形成活跃的普查之下，生成不息恰当止息复现（Web.ceasing_of_arising、Web.unceasing_iff_bounded）。读于世界：每步至多 B 个关系项活跃且被列出的世界（World.CountedWithin）中，生起复现恰当止息复现（World.CountedWithin.arising_iff_ceasing）；有限世界的每个普查都有界（World.Finite.countedWithin），所以有限世界的规律 World.arising_iff_ceasing 是其情形（World.Finite.arising_iff_ceasing）；procession（关系项 x 只在第 x 步活跃）每步一个活跃，生起与止息都复现，关系项却不是有限多个（World.procession_world），所以这一规律越出有限世界；dawn 有普查而无界，生起复现而止息不复现（World.dawn_unbounded）。读于水平：所立者的普查每步至多 B 个时，开始作为条件而在复现恰当不再作为条件而在复现（Web.StandingCensus.coming_iff_ceasing）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once, at most B at each step (Listed, with lists no longer than B), and the determination is decided at each step, members coming to hold at arbitrarily late steps need members ceasing to hold at arbitrarily late steps (Listed.ceasing_of_coming). The proof: from some step N on, a coming to be not preceded by a ceasing to be leaves every member holding at N still holding, and the one that came to be was not listed at N, so the list is longer than at N (Listed.ceases_or_kept, Listed.ceases_or_more); the list cannot grow past B, so something ceases to be after N (Listed.ceases_within). With the census law (ceasing-needs-arising), the two recur together (Listed.coming_iff_ceasing). Read of activity: under a census with at most B formations active at each step, generation is unceasing exactly when ceasing recurs (Web.ceasing_of_arising, Web.unceasing_iff_bounded). Read of worlds: in a world whose relata active at each step are listed, at most B of them (World.CountedWithin), arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.CountedWithin.arising_iff_ceasing); every census of a finite world is bounded (World.Finite.countedWithin), so the law of finite worlds, World.arising_iff_ceasing, is a case (World.Finite.arising_iff_ceasing); in procession, where relatum x is active at step x alone, one relatum is active at each step and arising and ceasing both recur, while the relata are not finitely many (World.procession_world), so the law reaches beyond finite worlds; dawn has a census without a bound, and arising recurs there while ceasing does not (World.dawn_unbounded). Read of standing: where at most B conditions stand at each step, listed, coming to stand recurs exactly when ceasing to stand does (Web.StandingCensus.coming_iff_ceasing). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 有界的列出：每步成立者被不重复地列出，列表的长度都不超过同一个 B；成员总共可以无限多。 / A bounded listing: the members holding at each step are listed, each once, with every list no longer than one bound B; there may be infinitely many members in all.
- 可判定：读于活动是活动可判定，读于水平自动成立；这是表示的逻辑承诺，经典地总是成立。 / Decidability: read of activity this is decided activity, read of standing it holds automatically; it is a logical commitment of the representation and classically always holds.
- procession_world、dawn_unbounded 与 Finite.countedWithin 分别是关于具体世界或有限世界的陈述；Finite.countedWithin 要求活动可判定。 / procession_world, dawn_unbounded and Finite.countedWithin are statements about particular worlds or about finite worlds; Finite.countedWithin needs decided activity.

§26 的有限家族定律（coming_recurs_iff、Web.unceasing_iff）要求一个固定的有限家族包含所有成员；这里只要求每步的列表有界，成员总共可以无限多。所以 §30 中“活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现与止息复现是同一部分”所需要的是计数的界，不是有限。与普查定律合起来，生起与止息的关系按计数分为三层：每步的活跃者有限且有界时，两者同步；每步有限而无界时，止息需要生起，反之不然（dawn）；每步不再有限时，止息可以独自不息（dusk 没有普查）。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在活跃者不超过一个界的展开中，持续的生起与持续的止息是同一个持续变化的两面，正如有限世界中那样，但不需要成员总共有限；更新的世代可以无穷，只要同时在场的有界。这是活动与水平的读法，不是 Ren 的“生成的”“退化的”，也不评价生起或止息。 / Section 26's law of a finite family (coming_recurs_iff, Web.unceasing_iff) needs one fixed finite family holding every member; here only the list at each step needs a bound, and the members may be infinitely many in all. So what section 30's law, that in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurring and ceasing recurring are one part, needs is a bound on the count, not finiteness. With the census law, the relation of arising and ceasing falls into three tiers by counting: with the active at each step finite and bounded, the two recur together; finite at each step but unbounded, ceasing needs arising and not conversely (dawn); no longer finite at each step, ceasing can recur alone (dusk has no census). The author's reading (an AI argument): in an unfolding whose active members never exceed a bound, lasting arising and lasting ceasing are two sides of one lasting change, as in a finite world, without the members being finitely many in all; renewed generations can be endless while those present together are bounded. This is a reading of activity and standing, not Ren's generative and degenerative, and it evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

要求一个对所有步统一的界；只从某步起有界的情形可由平移得到，但未陈述；只对离散步陈述；要求可判定（逻辑承诺）；不说哪个成员开始或不再成立，也不说两者有因果关联：本规律是计数，不是机制；复现不给出频率或比率；不评价生起或止息；名称（有界普查、procession）由 Ren 定。 / Needs one bound for all steps; the case bounded only from some step on follows by shifting but is not stated; stated for discrete steps; needs decidability (a logical commitment); says neither which member comes to be or ceases nor that the two are causally linked: the law is a count, not a mechanism; recurrence gives no frequency or rate; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; the names (bounded census, procession) are Ren's to choose.
